title: Chief Executive Order 3 Governors Appointment And Oath Of Office Amendment Order 2002

sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 3 Governors Appointment And Oath Of Office Amendment Order 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

GOVERNORS APPOINTMENT AND OATH OF OFFICE (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
GOVERNORS APPOINTMENT AND OATH OF OFFICE
(AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXEC'UTIVE'S
ORDER 3 OF 2002
(An order to amend
the Governors Appointment and Oath of Office Order, 1999)
No.2-24199/99-Min.1I,
dated 25-2-2002.
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Governors Appointment and Oath of Office Order, 1999 (Chief Executive's
Order No.4 of 1999), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
l. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Order may be called the Governors Appointment and
Oath of Office (Amendment) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

dated 25-2-2002.
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Governors Appointment and Oath of Office Order, 1999 (Chief Executive's
Order No.4 of 1999), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
2. Amendment of Schedule,
Chief Executive's Order No.4 of
1999.---In the Governors Appointment and Oath of Office Order, 1999 (Chief
Executive's Order No. 4 of 1999), in the Schedule, in the third paragraph for
the words, commas and figure "issued by the Chairman Joint Chiefs of Staff
Committee. Chief of Army Staff and the Chief Executive of the Islamic Republic
of Pakistan on the Fourteenth day of October, 1999 and all subsequent Orders
issued by him the words "and all subsequent Orders made or issued by the
Chief Executive at the Islamic Republic of Pakistan" shall be substituted.
